_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wɔrekyere Klondike Solitaire. W'abrabɔ ne sɛ wɔbɛfa kaad nnyinaa kɔ foundation piles.

Mmara a wɔde di dwuma:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Si kaad firi Ace kɔpem King wɔ suit mu
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Si kaad so wɔ nkrɔnkrɔn kɔla (kɔkɔɔ wɔ tuntum, tuntum wɔ kɔkɔɔ)
- Stock: Fa kaad firi stock kɔ waste pile
- Waste (W): Kaad a ɛwɔ soro pɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa

Nkyerɛkyerɛmu:
- 'draw' - Fa kaad firi stock kɔ waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Fa kaad firi ɔfa kɔ kɔ
  Nhwehwɛmu: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count nso betumi ayɛ 'all', a wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa kaad nnyinaa a ɛwɔ anim.
- 'forfeit' - Bɔ dwumadie no ɛnɛ na wɔkyekyere w'agorɔ a ɛwɔ soro
- Pile din: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Wobɛtumi ayɛ nnwuma pii wɔ kwan baako mu sɛ wɔde comma na ɛkyekyere:
  Nhwehwɛmu: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Nkwaadɔm pɛ sɛ wɔbɛsi no wɔ tableau piles a ɛwɔ hɔ.
Nnwuma no bɛyɛ wɔ kwan no - sɛ ɛbaako antumi, a wɔbɛkye nnwuma a aka no.
Fa 'forfeit' sɛ w'adwen ho sɛ dwumadie no nnyɛ hwee sɛ wɔbɛdi nkonim.

format_error.no_brackets: Akwan a ɛmfata. Ɛsɛ sɛ akwan no yɛ brackets mu.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no ho nteɛ. Nkyinkyimfo bracket nni hɔ ']'
format_error.empty_command: Akwankyerɛ a enni mu. Twerɛ 'draw' anaa 'move <source><destination> [count]'.
format_error.move_needs_args: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu 'move' hia ɔfa ne kɔ. Sɛdeɛ wɔde di dwuma: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Nsɛm a wɔka no 'count' no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ positive anaa 'all'.
format_error.count_invalid: Nsɛm a wɔka no 'count' no yɛ saa. Sɛ wɔka number anaa 'all'.
